fee_notes: Affiliation fee for new franchises is $500 per room with a $50,000 minimum; $750 per room with a $65,000 minimum for transfers and renewals. A non-refundable application fee of $5,000 is collected and credited toward the affiliation fee. During the 12 months ending December 31, 2025, affiliation fees ranged from $0 to $75,000 for COMFORT INN, COMFORT INN & SUITES, or COMFORT SUITES franchise agreements. Fees may be reduced in certain circumstances (multiple unit franchisees, larger properties, prior dealings, departing other chains, or other special circumstances).
